description:
*** ALPHA SOFTWARE -- THE API IS NOT STABLE ***

        Pre-1.0 and under active development. Anything public may be added,
        renamed or removed in any release, breaking code that compiles today,
        with no deprecation period first. A 0.x version carries no
        compatibility promise and these are used that way: treat every bump
        as potentially breaking. Pin an exact version. Not recommended for
        production use.

        The expression language a manager writes a participant panel in, and
        the one evaluator of it. A closed grammar over a participant's private
        state, the marketplace's shared state, and their holdings: field
        references, arithmetic, comparison, a conditional, and the handful of
        vector functions the studies in fm-robots require. No loops, no
        user-defined functions, no I/O, no reach into another participant's
        state.

        One evaluator on purpose. The live panel in fm-server and the offline
        settlement in fm-robots must show and pay the same number, and two
        implementations of one formula agree by test where one agrees by
        construction. Decimal throughout: intermediate arithmetic at scale
        six, never binary floating point.

        No dependencies. Callers hand it a Scope resolving references to
        values; what a holding or a state row looks like is their business.
